svg.title: SA89853 schematic diagram
svg.desc: Schematic of the SA89853 16-channel ADC, redrawn from the datasheet with the values from its bill of materials. GPIO2 and GPIO3 each have a 47 kΩ pull-up (R1) to VBD. REFM goes to ground, the external reference drives REFP, and a 10 µF capacitor C1 connects REFP to REFM. Each VA pin has C1 (10 µF) and C2 (0.1 µF) to the neighbouring AGND pin, which goes to ground; VBD has the same pair to BDGND. MXO connects to AINP, and AINM goes to ground. Every input, CH0 to CH15, comes in through a 33 Ω resistor (R2) with a 270 pF capacitor (C3) to ground at the pin. GPIO0, GPIO1, SDO, SDI, SCLK and CS_N go to the controller.
